hook: Simmer is a tiny Mac menu bar app
hookText: Simmer is a tiny Mac menu bar app

beats.say: Coding agents and automated UI tests now spin up their own simulators and often do not clean up after themselves.
Simmer's menu bar icon changes color by how long simulators have been open, on the theory that under an hour is normal and anything longer was probably forgotten.
Today I'm releasing Simmer, a menu bar app for the Mac that monitors the simulators running on your device.
